topics.title: Conservation groups weigh AI's trade-offs
topics.summary: Environmental groups are using AI to track wildlife, analyze climate data and flag wildfire risks, while also warning that the data centers behind it can consume substantial electricity and water.
topics.discussionPrompt: Would you use a power-hungry tool if it helped protect forests and wildlife much faster? What rules would make that feel fair?

topics.title: Satellites spotlight landfill methane
topics.summary: Satellite observations have highlighted methane escaping from a large landfill near Istanbul as Turkey prepares to host COP31. The story underlines both the promise and difficulty of reducing waste-related emissions.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a city could tackle one messy climate problem first, would you pick landfill waste, traffic, home heating, or something else?

topics.title: A white dwarf wears two debris rings
topics.summary: Astronomers have spotted a white dwarf surrounded by two rings of planetary debris, offering a rare glimpse of what can remain after a star evolves and reshapes its planetary system.
topics.discussionPrompt: If humans could leave one harmless object drifting around a future star, what tiny time capsule would best represent us?

topics.title: Pakistan plans a space-station visitor
topics.summary: Chinese state media said a Pakistani astronaut will join China's space station on the Shenzhou-24 mission, a planned step in the countries' space cooperation.
topics.discussionPrompt: If you could invite one international guest to your orbital station, what skill would they bring to the crew?

topics.title: Robotics deal faces a China rethink
topics.summary: SoftBank and ABB are reportedly exploring a carve-out of the Chinese portion of a proposed $5.4 billion robotics deal after Beijing blocked the transaction, according to Bloomberg News.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a giant business deal gets tangled in borders and rules, what matters most: local jobs, competition, security, or keeping innovation moving?

topics.title: Port labor talks get more time
topics.summary: Employers at the Los Angeles and Long Beach ports and an ILWU local extended their bargaining deadline to November 20, averting a potential strike while talks continue.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a negotiation gets an extension instead of a showdown, is that encouraging, exhausting, or both? What helps people stay patient?

topics.title: National Trust debates its banking partner
topics.summary: Members of the UK's National Trust backed a move to seek a banking partner more aligned with its environmental policies, bringing financial choices into a wider conversation about conservation.
topics.discussionPrompt: Should clubs and community groups choose banks partly by values, or focus only on price and service? How would you decide?

topics.title: UN chief calls climate talks a turning point
topics.summary: Ahead of climate talks in Turkey, outgoing UN Secretary-General António Guterres urged leaders to treat the effort to curb global warming as a decisive moment for collective action.
topics.discussionPrompt: Big problems can make people tune out. What kind of local climate project would actually make you want to join in?

topics.title: Film social platform may get a new owner
topics.summary: The New York Times Company is reportedly in exclusive talks to acquire film-focused social platform Letterboxd, a move that could broaden its portfolio beyond news, games and product reviews.
topics.discussionPrompt: If you owned a movie diary app, what playful feature would you add: themed watch parties, mystery picks, tiny reviews, or something else?

topics.title: Rybakina reaches the WTA Finals title match
topics.summary: Elena Rybakina came back from a set down to beat Jessica Pegula and reach the WTA Finals championship match, setting up a chance at her first season-ending title.
topics.discussionPrompt: What makes a comeback fun to watch: a change in tactics, stubborn confidence, the crowd getting loud, or a little bit of chaos?
